name: feat.daggerheart-domain-card-siphon-essence-feature
description: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Very Close range. On a success, once per long rest, the target takes d20 magic damage using your Proficiency. You clear a number of Hit Points equal to the number of Hit Points the target marked from this attack. On a success with Fear, you gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency for this attack.
